description: Use this when the user asks what the European Parliament voted on a sitting day, this week, between two dates or on a subject, e.g. "what did Parliament vote today" or "votes on Ukraine in October". Without arguments it returns the latest sitting day; with only a query it searches the last 92 days. Votes are grouped by agenda item; each item has its deciding (final) vote with result and totals and the ids of its other votes for get_vote. Lists at most 40 items.

from.description: Start of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD (with to).

query.description: Keep only agenda items whose topic, title or vote labels contain these words, e.g. "psychosocial".

this_week.description: All votes of the current week.

to.description: End of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD (with from).

name: list_votes
title: List plenary votes
